spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

Evaṁ vutte, esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: When he had spoken, Esukārī said to him: Tatridaṁ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa sandhanaṁ paññapenti kasigorakkhaṁ; The wealth they prescribe for a peasant is farming and animal husbandry.

spans.text: Evaṁ vutte, esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: When he had spoken, Esukārī said to him: Tatridaṁ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa sandhanaṁ paññapenti kasigorakkhaṁ; The wealth they prescribe for a peasant is farming and animal husbandry.
Tatridaṁ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṁ paññapenti asitabyābhaṅgiṁ; The wealth they prescribe for a menial is the scythe and flail.
Tatridaṁ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṁ paññapenti bhikkhācariyaṁ; The wealth they prescribe for a brahmin is living on alms.
Tatridaṁ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṁ paññapenti dhanukalāpaṁ; The wealth they prescribe for an aristocrat is the bow and quiver.
